title: Grateful Dead Live at Academy of Music on 1972-03-28

ai_review.summary: A great Dead show captured on a poor‑quality audience tape that makes listening difficult
ai_review.review: Reviewers agree the concert itself is strong – fans note an enthusiastic crowd and a memorable moment during “Cumberland Blues” – but the audio is described as horrid, muddy and often unlistenable. The recording (an audience source) is considered far inferior to other available tapes, limiting its practical enjoyment despite the solid performance.

ai_rating.rationale: The show receives praise for energy and performance, but multiple reviewers label the sound quality as terrible or unlistenable; this heavy weighting toward poor audio drags the overall rating down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviews repeatedly call the sound "horrid", "unlistenable" and note severe SQ issues, though some say it is marginally better than other sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific set‑list comments; reviewers only mention overall excitement and a notable moment on "Cumberland Blues".
